title: ESG-Kor: A Korean Dataset for ESG-related Information Extraction and Practical Use Cases
abstract: arXiv:2610.21368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the expansion of pre-trained language model usage in recent years, the importance of datasets for performing tasks in specialized domains has significantly increased. Therefore, we have built a Korean dataset called ESG-Kor to automatically extract Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) information, which has recently gained importance. ESG-Kor is a dataset consisting of a total of 118,946 sentences that extracted information on each ESG component from Korean companies' sustainability reports and manually labeled it according to objective rules provided by ESG evaluation agencies. To verify the effectiveness and applicability of the ESG-Kor dataset, classification performance was confirmed using several Korean pre-trained language models, and significant performance was obtained. translated_title: ESG-Kor：用于ESG相关信息提取及实际应用场景的韩语数据集
translated_abstract: 随着近年来预训练语言模型应用的扩展，用于专业领域任务执行的数据集的重要性显著提升。因此，我们构建了一个名为ESG-Kor的韩语数据集，用于自动提取近年来日益受到重视的环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息。ESG-Kor是一个总共包含118,946个句子的数据集，其内容从韩国企业的可持续发展报告中提取各ESG组成部分的信息，并依据ESG评估机构提供的客观规则进行人工标注。为验证ESG-Kor数据集的有效性和适用性，我们使用多个韩语预训练语言模型确认了分类性能，并取得了显著的成果。此外，通过将ESG分类模型扩展应用于中小企业文档，并基于ESG关键议题提取相关信息……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文构建了包含118,946个句子的韩语ESG信息提取数据集ESG-Kor，其数据源自韩国企业可持续发展报告并按ESG评估机构的客观规则人工标注，验证了韩语预训练语言模型在ESG分类任务上的显著性能，并进一步将该模型扩展应用于中小企业的ESG信息提取。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ESG-Kor, a Korean dataset of 118,946 sentences extracted from Korean companies' sustainability reports and manually labeled according to objective rules from ESG evaluation agencies, demonstrating strong classification performance with Korean pre-trained language models and extending its application to ESG information extraction from SME documents.
